Risk-Based Approach to Supplier Assessments   
Risk Assessment 1 (RA1)
High-level (one-page) analysis used to determine whether a speciﬁc supplier facility 
is a potential high-risk facility. The assessment covers a number of risk factors, plus 
geographic location, product(s) or service(s) provided, and corporate responsibility 
concerns.
High-risk suppliers move to RA2
Risk Assessment 2 (RA2)
Requires a supplier to respond to an in-depth, online self-assessment questionnaire 
with more than 300 questions to determine a facility’s potential high-risk areas. 
RA2 goes into greater detail than RA1 and covers all sections of the EICC Code.
High-risk suppliers move to RA3
Risk Assessment 3 (RA3)
Consists of an on-site third-party audit conducted for customers. The audit covers 
all sections of the EICC Code and evaluates risk according to the number of 
compliance concerns and/or critical areas at that location.
Audit completed and corrective action plan put in place
